info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Kestrel Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Kestrel Jacket Detail Management API allows businesses to efficiently manage the details of the Kestrel Jacket within their product catalog. This endpoint enables the submission of comprehensive details about the jacket, including specifications, pricing, and availability. Typical users of this API include e-commerce platforms, inventory management systems, and marketing teams seeking to enhance their product listings. By streamlining the process of cataloging product information, companies can improve their operational efficiency and ensure accurate and up-to-date data for customers.

post.summary: Create new details for a Kestrel jacket.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and submit detailed information about a Kestrel jacket. Use this operation to add specifications, features, and other relevant data to enhance the product catalog.
